method: D2Q9(257) from rest through k=32768 inclusive, followed by frozen korrektur_hankel outputs on top of D2Q9(65) from rest
switch_basis: At Re=1000 both budgets were met at all sampled k >=16384. Use twice that tick as the boundary and freeze before computing Re=975.
initial_condition: interior at rest, moving lid prescribed
selection: use the archived main-series Hankel correction without retraining, adjustment or blending on 975. Ground truth at neither target is a model input after the switch. All 315 positive samples must pass.
